notes:
Account: Translingo SearchWorks — global legal-tech search product for multinational law firms. Primary focus: cross-lingual RAG pipeline + reranking.

Current status / needs:
- Running a POC: ingest pipeline for mixed-format legal docs (pdfs, briefs, precedents). Starting with 150k docs; target scale 5–20M in phase 2.
- Languages of interest: English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Portuguese, Arabic. Need >30 language coverage long-term.
- Retrieval stack: embeddings index + lightweight ANN for candidate retrieval + neural cross-lingual reranker. Want per-language recall/precision tuning and separate evals by language.
- Latency targets: 95th pctile end-to-end <250ms for single-shot query in EU region for legal Q&A; if reranker enabled target <500ms.
- Throughput: bursty courtroom/presentation loads ~200 qps peak for enterprise tier; baseline 20 qps steady.
- Cost sensitivity: high — procurement expects unit cost (per-query) analysis at 100k q/mo and 2M q/mo. Need Redwood Optimize guidance on batching/caching/quantization tradeoffs.
- Model preferences: open multilingual embedding models that support cross-lingual alignment; prefer smaller quantized variants for reranker cost reduction. Interested in Redwood recommendations (model+quantization) per language.
- Routing / fallback: want policy to route high-sensitivity queries to Private (on-prem) nodes, fallback to Dedicated hosted models if local capacity constrained.
- Compliance: strict data residency for EU client data; KMS/HSM required for key management; full audit logs and retention controls.

POC specifics and acceptance criteria:
- Ingest 150k pilot, compute embeddings, build ANN index, run retrieval+rerank test set (per-lang test sets).
- Evaluation metrics: precision@5, recall@100, MRR, response latency. Expect to provide per-language baseline and >15% improvement with tuned reranker.
- Cost evaluation: capture per-query token and compute cost for 3 config variants (no rerank / lightweight rerank / heavy rerank).
- Delivery timeline: POC baseline (pilot) by 2024-12-20; scale tests (1M) by 2025-01-30.
